name: Holographic Extreme Cache
author: Holographic

sections.description:
Holographic Extreme Cache gives WordPress sites a faster, cleaner caching layer with safe defaults and practical performance tools.

It includes advanced static page caching, intelligent cache clearing, WooCommerce-safe exclusions, preload support, HTML minification, WordPress emoji disabling, browser cache helper rules, homepage speed testing and cache diagnostics.

Built for real WordPress sites, it helps pages load faster while avoiding risky one-size-fits-all optimisation. Smart clearing keeps cached content fresher, WooCommerce-safe rules protect dynamic shop pages, and built-in diagnostics make performance easier to trust.

Features

  • Static HTML page caching.
  • PHP fallback cache delivery.
  • advanced-cache.php drop-in support.
  • Optional Apache rewrite helper rules.
  • Manual clear cache button.
  • Admin bar cache clearing.
  • Automatic cache clearing when content changes.
  • Basic smart purge for posts, pages, archives, taxonomy archives, authors and homepage.
  • Cache lifetime control.
  • Basic preload for homepage, recent posts and recent pages.
  • Combined cache and preload controls for simpler setup.
  • Safe default exclusions.
  • WooCommerce cart, checkout and account exclusions.
  • Logged-in user bypass by default.
  • POST, AJAX, REST, preview and unsafe query string bypass.
  • Cache size and cached page count.
  • Last purge and last preload time.
  • Basic cache health check.
  • Other caching plugin conflict detection.
  • Debug response headers.
  • Strong cached HTML and inline CSS minification.
  • Disable WordPress emoji files option.
  • Browser cache helper.
  • Gzip and Brotli detection.
  • Setup tab with one-click WP_CACHE handling where wp-config.php is writable.
  • Simple homepage speed test for cache-off and cache-on comparison with expandable diagnostics.
  • Safe and Balanced modes.
  • Optional uninstall cleanup.

Privacy

Holographic Extreme Cache does not collect analytics, does not track visitors and does not send site data to a third-party service.

The plugin stores cache files, configuration helper files and optional log files inside its own folder under the WordPress uploads directory. Logging is off by default.

Uninstall

The plugin can remove its settings, cache files, configuration files, log files and scheduled events on uninstall if the uninstall cleanup option is enabled before uninstalling.

If uninstall cleanup is not enabled, settings and generated files are left in place so the site owner can remove or inspect them manually.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate Holographic Extreme Cache.
  3. Open Holo-Cache in the admin menu.
  4. Use the Setup tab to check WP_CACHE, cache delivery and helper options.
  5. Enable caching from the Dashboard or Cache tab.
  6. Use the homepage speed test to confirm the cache is working.
sections.faq:
What does Holographic Extreme Cache actually do?

Holographic Extreme Cache creates static HTML versions of eligible WordPress pages so they can load faster for visitors. It also includes smart cache clearing, preload support, WooCommerce-aware exclusions, browser cache helper rules, speed checks and diagnostics.

Is Holographic Extreme Cache suitable for WooCommerce sites?

Yes. The plugin includes WooCommerce-aware cache rules for cart, checkout, account, order and session behaviour. It is designed to keep dynamic shopping areas safe while still allowing normal public pages and product content to benefit from caching.

Will it clear the right pages when I update content?

Holographic Extreme Cache includes smart cache clearing for common WordPress changes. When content changes, the plugin can clear relevant cached pages instead of forcing you to manually rebuild the whole cache every time.

Does it help rebuild the cache after it has been cleared?

Yes. The plugin includes preload support so important pages can be warmed again after cache clearing. This helps reduce the number of first visitors who hit uncached pages after updates.

How do I know whether the cache is working?

The plugin includes cache diagnostics, response headers, homepage speed testing and health checks. These tools help confirm whether pages are being cached, served correctly and cleared when expected.

Can I exclude pages that should not be cached?

Yes. Holographic Extreme Cache includes exclusion controls for pages and request types that should stay dynamic. This is useful for forms, accounts, carts, checkouts and other areas where fresh or personalised content matters.

Does it include optimisation features beyond page caching?

Yes. The free plugin includes safe HTML minification, WordPress emoji disabling and browser cache helper rules. Holographic Extreme Cache Pro adds advanced optimisation features such as image conversion, Critical CSS, Cloudflare support, CDN rewriting, per-page optimisation profiles and safer Pro controls.

What is the difference between the free plugin and Pro?

The free plugin focuses on fast static page caching, smart clearing, safe exclusions, preload and diagnostics. Pro adds a wider optimisation layer, including on-server WebP and AVIF conversion where supported, Critical CSS, advanced preload, Cloudflare, CDN rewriting, Safe Mode, WooCommerce diagnostics, per-page optimisation profiles, performance reports and rollback tools.

  • Updated the cache speed-check wording.
